# deBridge Agent Skills

> Cross-chain DeFi agent skills for bridging, swapping, signing, and
> monitoring across 20+ EVM chains and Solana. Use with deBridge MCP
> server, SDK, or CLI.

## Skills

- [debridge-common](skills/common/SKILL.md): Shared prerequisite for all deBridge agent skills.
- [debridge-analytics](skills/analytics/SKILL.md): Query DeFi analytics and on-chain data from third-party MCP servers to make informed bridging and swapping decisions.
- [debridge-signing](skills/signing/SKILL.md): Sign and broadcast deBridge transactions.
- [debridge-swap](skills/swap/SKILL.md): Execute token swaps, bridges, and cross-chain transfers via deBridge DLN.
- [debridge-wallets](skills/wallets/SKILL.md): Set up a wallet for deBridge transactions.
